Lessons.Title: Comparing Transformations
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Determine what information is needed to sketch a transformation of a function and create its equation. Ask questions to elicit that information.
A family y=D+A sin(k(x-h)) has amplitude |A|, period2π/|k|, horizontal displacement h and midline D. Ask for missing parameters before claiming a unique model.

Source activity 17.1: Three Functions: For each pair of graphs, be prepared to describe a transformation from the graph on top to the graph on bottom. Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.

Source activity 17.3: Match the Graph: Here is the graph of \(f(x)=\cos(x)\) and the graph of \(g\), which is a transformation of \(f\). Identify a transformation that takes \(f\) to \(g\) and write an equation for \(g\) in terms of \(f\) matching the transformation. Identify at least one other transformation that takes \(f\) to \(g\) and write an equation for \(g\) in terms of \(f\) matching the transformation.… Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Applying an algebraic solution at an excluded input.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: A zero denominator or impossible physical quantity makes the result invalid.
CommonMistakes.Correction: State and check the domain before finalising.
